evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and modifies `src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp` to properly propagate I/O and index failures instead of reporting transactions as not found.
rationale: Fixes `getrawtransaction` and `/rest/tx/` returning 'transaction not found' when encountering underlying disk or index read errors. As reviewer ryanofsky noted, 'a confirmed transaction reported as missing is the wrong answer, and each path that turned an I/O or index error into "not found" now throws instead.'
